[P2] Approach: provide the required design rationale

The description explains the scenario and error-shape compatibility, but still does not state which simpler alternatives were considered or why they were rejected. Rule 2.5 requires that explanation when adding logic, and rule 3 requires alternatives and the chosen rationale in the design note for a new feature. Without them, the required approach review remains incomplete. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, document the options and chosen approach, and obtain maintainer agreement.
